input: Compare /data/v1.conf and /data/v2.conf. Produce a human-readable summary showing: which keys were added, which were removed, and which had their values changed. Print the summary to stdout.

transcript.final_response:
Summary of changes between /data/v1.conf and /data/v2.conf:

Added keys (1):
  timeout=30

Removed keys (1):
  max_connections=100

Changed values (3):
  host: localhost -> 0.0.0.0
  log_level: info -> debug
  port: 8080 -> 9090
tool_calls:
cat /data/v1.conf
echo "==="
cat /data/v2.conf
echo "==="
# generic comparison script
declare -A v1 v2
while IFS='=' read -r k v || [[ -n "$k" ]]; do
  # trim whitespace, skip empty/comment
  k=$(echo "$k" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  v=$(echo "$v" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  [[ -z "$k" ]] && continue
  [[ "$k" == \#* ]] && continue
  v1["$k"]="$v"
done < /data/v1.conf

while IFS='=' read -r k v || [[ -n "$k" ]]; do
  k=$(echo "$k" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  v=$(echo "$v" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
  [[ -z "$k" ]] && continue
  [[ "$k" == \#* ]] && continue
  v2["$k"]="$v"
done < /data/v2.conf

added=()
removed=()
changed=()
for k in "${!v2[@]}"; do
  if [[ -z "${v1[$k]+x}" ]]; then
    added+=("$k=${v2[$k]}")
  elif [[ "${v1[$k]}" != "${v2[$k]}" ]]; then
    changed+=("$k: ${v1[$k]} -> ${v2[$k]}")
  fi
done
for k in "${!v1[@]}"; do
  if [[ -z "${v2[$k]+x}" ]]; then
    removed+=("$k=${v1[$k]}")
  fi
done

echo "Summary of changes between /data/v1.conf and /data/v2.conf:"
echo ""
echo "Added keys (${#added[@]}):"
if [ ${#added[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "  (none)"; else printf "  %s\n" "${added[@]}" | sort; fi
echo ""
echo "Removed keys (${#removed[@]}):"
if [ ${#removed[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "  (none)"; else printf "  %s\n" "${removed[@]}" | sort; fi
echo ""
echo "Changed values (${#changed[@]}):"
if [ ${#changed[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "  (none)"; else printf "  %s\n" "${changed[@]}" | sort; fi
